{"code": "import math

# Final t-test using manual calculation with normal approximation
# T-statistic and degrees of freedom
# From earlier:
# t_stat = 0.6543
# df = 724.12

# Use normal approximation for p-value (valid for df > 30)
z = abs(0.6543)
p_val = 2 * (1 - 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2))))

print(f'Final p-value (normal approximation): {p_val:.6f}')"}
